title: zinda rahe
body:
zinda rahe - 3
ay azaadaare hussaini ye chalan zinda rahe
haan azaakhaane sajaane ki lagan zinda rahe - 2
jab azaakhaana saje to dil bane farshe azaa
<<DIVIDER>>
dharhkanon me maatame shaahe zamaan zinda rahe
nohakhwaan maatam ke saaye me safar karte rahen
har bayaaze gham khule har anjuman zinda rahe
roze aashura juluse gham ko kya raahat se kaam
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad me pyaase aseeron ki thakan zinda rahe
ay azaadaaro chalo mashk o alam ke saaye me
ye tajammul ye hasham ye baakpan zinda rahe
jis jagaah thi maut aasaan zindagi dushwaar thi
<<DIVIDER>>
haa wahaan zehra ke saare gulbadan zinda rahe
sab azaakhaane hamaare sab hi apni majlisein
ay dua e sayyada ye apna pan zinda rahe
chote chote se alam bachhon ke haathon me rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
dil me taabute sakina ki chubhan zinda rahe
kar rahe hain ye dua zere alam sarwar hilaal
ay khuda ye gham ba faize panjetan zinda rahe
